content: invalidValue is inside the limits of the compuMethod , handled by software-components If the invalidValue is inside the range limits defined by the compuMethod , it is visible (known) to the communicating software-components. In this case, the software-components can directly read and write the value. This is in particular the case, if the sender and receiver are calculating a check- sum over a larger data structure to implement an end-to-end communication pro- tection. 341 of 1277 Document ID 62: AUTOSAR_CP_TPS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R25-11 To ensure the integrity of the checksums, it is required to set invalid values by the sending component directly, and to receive invalid values unchanged.

Sender and receiver have knowledge of invalid value On the other hand it is possible that the communicating software components do have knowledge about the invalidValue and the invalidValue is visible for them. This is in particular the case if the sender and receiver are calculating a checksum over a larger data structure to implement an end to end communication protec- tion.
